title: Row packing and soft-resize affordances for mixed-content virtual tables
creator: Samira Nguyen
description:
Problem: Our virtualized table currently assumes mostly uniform row heights and hard column resize rails. In mixed-content rows (multi-line text, badges, inline charts) this leads to janky scrolling, visual overlap when columns shrink, and poor perceived performance.

Goal: Design a cohesive set of patterns that: (1) improve visual continuity for variable-height rows via row-packing and measurement-friendly placeholders, (2) introduce a soft-resize affordance for columns that lets users compress/expand without immediate layout thrash, and (3) define tokens and CSS/JS contracts so engineering can implement efficient virtualization and measurement sampling.

Scope: Desktop and tablet breakpoints for the main table component in the design system. Does not include mobile stack/list fallback (follow-up ticket). Work includes high-fidelity comps, interactive prototypes (Figma/Framer), accessibility guidelines, and an implementation readiness spec for ENG.

Key design principles: preserve scroll stability, minimize reflows during resize, keep keyboard + screen-reader affordances consistent, surface density presets while avoiding feature bloat.
deliverables: Figma file with 3 density presets (compact, regular, relaxed) and mixed-content examples
Interactive prototype showing soft-resize rail with preview thumbnail and snap thresholds
Design spec for measurement API: visibleHeightHint, estimatedRowHeight, measurementSamplingRate
Accessibility notes: aria-live behavior for column changes, keyboard interactions for resize, screen-reader announcements for sorting/filtering
Acceptance criteria checklist and handoff doc for ENG (includes CSS tokens and recommended JS hooks)
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates stable scroll position when resizing columns by up to 30% on mixed content rows
Engineering can implement virtualization without significant custom per-table heuristics (uses suggested measurement API)
Design tokens provided for spacing, rowGap, compactRowLineHeight, and resize-rail thickness
Keyboard resize + modifier behavior documented and passes manual a11y test flow
Performance targets: no frame drops >100ms during typical drag flows on mid-tier machines (tracked with simple perf harness)
dependencies: ENG-34122 (virtualization: measurement API and sample registry)
ENG-34785 (resize-rail pointer handling and momentum smoothing)
PM-2210 (prioritize table backlog and release cadence)
